_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contract Invoicing and Payment Report
summary: The Contract Invoicing and Payment Report collects financial and accounting information on CLINs and ACRNs within an awarded contract to manage obligations, disbursements, un-liquidated obligations, and canceling accounts associated with appropriated funds.
use_relationship:
The Contract Invoicing and Payment Report collects financial and accounting information associated with contract line item numbers (CLINs) and accounting requirements classification numbers (ACRNs) within an awarded contract, which will be used to manage obligations, disbursements, un-liquidated obligations, and canceling accounts associated with appropriated funds.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the content, preparation instructions and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Data will be submitted electronically and may be in contractor format.

children.title: A listing of each CLIN and subline item number (SLIN) along with the following information for each CLIN/SLIN:
Total CLIN/SLIN value as contained in the contract.
Cumulative amount invoiced for the CLIN/SLIN.
CLIN/SLIN funds remaining.
children.content: (Difference between CLIN/SLIN funded and invoiced amounts)

children.title: Percent invoiced of funded amount.
children.content: (Invoiced amount as a percentage of funded amount)

children.title: Deductions for the period.
children.content: (Amount of any performance deductions taken against the CLIN/SLIN during the reporting period)

children.title: Cumulative total of all deductions taken against the CLIN/SLIN.
Amount of payment received against the CLIN/SLIN.
Totaled amounts for all entries for items a.2 through a.9.
